name: Illusion of Choice
source:
You are broke. Finally figured out that you can't live off by making videos on newtube , you applied to a job. How could you know that this would lead to your end. What could you choose to prevent that, why is it happening ... Welcome to eternal loop of choices where there is every ending and no ending at all. So how will you break the cycle?

This game is made for Yandere Game Jam 2023.

[From [url=https://denniyopi.itch.io/illusionofchoice]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你没钱了。终于认清靠在newtube上做视频养不活自己后，你申请了一份工作。你怎么也想不到，这竟会将你引向末路。究竟该作出什么选择，才能阻止这一切？它为什么会发生……欢迎来到永无止境的选择循环，这里拥有所有结局，却又没有任何真正的结局。那么，你要如何打破循环？

本作为Yandere Game Jam 2023制作。

[摘自[url=https://denniyopi.itch.io/illusionofchoice]Itch.io[/url]]
